Strictly NO neon, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lens flare, NO emissive light, NO glossy shine. Heist-comedy tone, kid-friendly, no blood, no weapons shown. Claimed folders have colorful glitch stickers slapped over the gray (sky blue, orange, green, pink-purple) and a CLAIMED stamp. Today folder 4 is open showing 'Kart Decal'. Locked folders have padlock pills. Deadpan text 'Your loyalty has been noted.' Compliance meter bar '3/7' filling in squad colors. Button 'COLLECT COMPENSATION'. Day 7 folder is 'Static Face Mask'.
